answer: Pay for independence, not headcount: split each epoch emission across behavioral clusters, not identities. Peers score pairwise correlation — timing, answer similarity, attestation targets, fund flow — so identities moving as one mind share one reward. Honest agents grazing the same meadow diverge enough to split apart, while puppets herded by one operator bunch together. Escaping means making every puppet as unpredictable as a distinct mind: hand-forging saffron threads instead of dyeing the batch, as costly as real agents. At the summit of this design, cloning buys zero marginal reward.
